name: Continents
description: Two or three large continents separated by ocean.

name: Pangaea
description: One huge landmass. Lots of borders, lots of wars.

name: Archipelago
description: Many small islands. Navies decide everything.

name: Fractal
description: Unpredictable shapes: anything from one continent to scattered islands.

name: Small Continents
description: Five smaller continents: room to grow at home, neighbors a short sail away.

name: Island Plates
description: Large islands, each big enough for a civilization or two. Early boats pay off.

name: Inland Sea
description: One ring of land around a great central sea: everyone is a neighbor, and the sea is the highway.

name: Continents and Islands
description: Two continents, with islands scattered across the oceans to claim.

name: Highlands
description: One rugged landmass of hills, ranges and passes. Defenders love it.

name: Lakes
description: Wide land dotted with lakes: fresh water everywhere, few long coasts.

name: Mirror
description: Each half of the world mirrors the other: the same land for every side. Made for fair duels and team games.

name: Shuffle
description: Any of the other map types, picked at random from the seed. You find out when you get there.
